additional_finding.description: test_variable_sample_period_consistency reveals that the synthetic fixture's physical durations (rise_s=200s, fall_s=200s) produce only 20 samples at 10s/sample — below MIN_CURVE_DURATION=60. This means the fixture is also insufficient to test finding 4 in isolation. Victory should either lower MIN_CURVE_DURATION or the fixture should use longer physical durations.
